{{Short description|Association of polling organizations}}
{{Distinguish|Gallup (company)|Gallup, New Mexico}}
The '''Gallup International Association''' ('''GIA''') is an association of [[opinion poll|polling]] organizations based in [[Zurich]], Switzerland. The Gallup International Association was founded in 1947 in Loxwood Hall, Sussex, UK. [[George Gallup|George H. Gallup]] served as its first President, until his death in 1984.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=2018-01-17|title=Gallup moves headquarters to Vienna|url=https://www.diepresse.com/5355312/gallup-verlegt-hauptquartier-nach-wien|website=[[Die Presse]]|language=de|access-date=2021-11-29|archive-date=2021-11-29|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211129120956/https://www.diepresse.com/5355312/gallup-verlegt-hauptquartier-nach-wien|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite book| url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3n5BA5Z_Of0C&q=%22gallup+international+association%22&pg=PA111| author=Wolfgang Donsbach and Michael W. Traugott| title=The SAGE handbook of public opinion research| publisher=Social Science| date=2007| isbn=9781412911771}}</ref> In January 2018, the management headquarters was relocated to [[Vienna]], Austria.<ref name=":0" />

[[Gallup (company)|Gallup, Inc.]] US and the Gallup International Association (GIA) were involved in a legal dispute over the use of the Gallup name.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Lavrakas|first=Paul J.|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=2sr0CAAAQBAJ&pg=PA299|title=Encyclopedia of Survey Research Methods|date=2008-09-12|publisher=[[SAGE Publications]]|isbn=978-1-5063-1788-5|location=United States|pages=299|language=en|access-date=2021-11-29|archive-date=2024-04-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240425144915/https://books.google.com/books?id=2sr0CAAAQBAJ&pg=PA299#v=onepage&q&f=false|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.akd.nl/en/knowledge/cases/gallup-international-association-vs-gallup-inc |title=Gallup International Association vs. Gallup Inc |accessdate=November 30, 2010 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110724143500/http://www.akd.nl/en/knowledge/cases/gallup-international-association-vs-gallup-inc |archive-date=July 24, 2011 }}</ref> Gallup International Association or its members are not related to Gallup Inc., headquartered in Washington DC, which is no longer a member of Gallup International Association.
